exposure: Fetal reduction to dichorionic diamniotic (DCDA) twins
outcome: Birth weight below the 10th and 3rd centiles
cohort: Higher-order multiple pregnancies reduced to DCDA twins, compared with primary DCDA twins and singleton pregnancies
finding: Reduced twins have similar obstetric and perinatal outcomes to primary twins, although both groups have significantly higher adverse outcomes compared to singleton pregnancies.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at reduction: 11.46 weeks; Mean gestational age at delivery: 33.48 weeks (reduced twins), 34.52 weeks (primary twins), 38.14 weeks (singletons)
